newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean edition of Glamour to be launched in Sept.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean edition of Glamour to be launched in Sept.

text.p: South Korea's Doosan Dong-A Co said on Thursday it signed a contract with Conde Nast International of the United States to launch the Korean edition of Glamour magazine in September.
The contract was signed on Tuesday in Seoul between Conde Nast International chairman Jonathan Newhouse and Doosan Dong-A chairman Yongmaan Park, Doosan Dong-A said in a statement.
It said the Korean edition would closely follow the original concept of Glamour, aimed at women and first created by Conde Nast in 1939 in the United States.
Doosan Dong-A is an affiliate of the Doosan Group, South Korea's 14th-largest industrial conglomerate.
Conde Nast announced earlier this week it would launch a Japanese edition of fashion magazine VOGUE, in a joint venture with Japanese publisher Nihon Keizai Shimbun.
The first Japanese edition will be published next March.
Conde Nast, which has 49 titles worldwide, is privately owned by the American Newhouse family and has plans to expand in the Asia-Pacific region.
